title: DEEPSEEK GENERAL_THEORY_SCAFFOLD AUDIT

canonical_node.axiom: The 30-atom pack is honestly labeled draft_proposal_not_canon; no atom may be promoted to canonical status without passing the Canon Promotion Rule from 17.
definitions: draft_proposal_not_canon: a status indicating the atom pack is a proposal, not canonical.
canonical bridge-status categories: 12 categories (Formal-internal candidate, Adversarial control, Definition/scaffold, Formal-internal).
canonical Level 0/1/2 roles: the standard roles defined in the canonical document.
orphaned bridge: a bridge with no direct canonical anchor or section.
misuse guard: a kill condition that prevents misuse rather than falsifying the model.
derivation: The audit compares each atom against canonical sections and vocabulary.
Global findings identify vocabulary drift, retired claims, and orphaned bridges.
Per-atom audit assigns alignment, drift, bridge grade, kill conditions, ontology family, and canonical section.
Upgrade list provides specific changes for global, physical, spiritual, and bridge atoms.
canonical_node.action: Apply the upgrade list to the atom pack: map bridge grades to canonical 12 categories, replace non-canonical role names, check target IDs, keep draft status, and sharpen kill conditions as specified.
boundary: Does not promote any atom to canonical status.
Does not derive new physics or theology.
Does not claim that any bridge is a proof.
Does not resolve orphaned bridges; marks them as orphaned.
test: Check that all bridge grades use canonical 12 vocabulary or are explicitly labeled draft-grade.
Check that no atom uses ruled-drifted variable names or retired claims.
Check that all kill conditions are model-level kills, not misuse guards.
Check that orphaned bridges are marked and not used as ME evidence.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides an audit and upgrade list for aligning a draft atom pack with canonical vocabulary and discipline.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the honest draft status and no-overclaim discipline of the pack.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this audit, the atom pack would remain misaligned with canonical vocabulary and risk overclaiming.
dg5_translation_registers: state_variable, boundary_condition, operator, failure_mode, actualization_gate, limit_condition  canonical Level 0/1/2 roles

overstatement_risks: The audit itself may be mistaken for a canonical promotion.
Upgrade suggestions may be treated as mandatory canonical changes.
Orphaned bridges may be ignored rather than removed.
kill_conditions: If any atom is promoted without passing Canon Promotion Rule.
If bridge grades are not mapped to canonical categories.
If orphaned bridges are used as ME evidence.
risk.lean_target: A lean version would retain only the global findings and the upgrade list, omitting per-atom details.

plain_summary: This document is an audit of a 30-atom draft pack, identifying vocabulary drift, orphaned bridges, and weak kill conditions, and providing an upgrade list to align with canonical discipline without promoting any atom.
